name: zog-parse-and-validation-execution-receipts
instr:
zog cannot currently explain how parsing or validation reached its result. Add durable execution receipts showing nested participation, value origins, failures, rollback, and commitment without rerunning callbacks or inferring behavior from issues.

Each completed receipt-enabled call returns an execution-local `ExecutionReceipt`. Its immutable `ReceiptObservation` values expose `ID`, `ParentID`, `Position`, `Path`, `SchemaType`, `Phase`, `Outcome`, and `IssueIndexes` through `(*ExecutionReceipt) Observations()`. They remain readable after issue collection and later executions.

The root `github.com/Oudwins/zog` package exports `ReceiptPhase`, `ReceiptOutcome`, `ReceiptObservation`, `ExecutionReceipt`, `ReceiptOptions`, and the schema methods below. `github.com/Oudwins/zog/parsers/zjson` exports `DecodeWithReceipt`; `github.com/Oudwins/zog/zhttp` exports `RequestWithReceipt`. `ReceiptPhase int` has `ReceiptPhaseParse = iota` and `ReceiptPhaseValidate`. `ReceiptOutcome int` has `ReceiptOutcomeAbsent = iota`, `ReceiptOutcomeAccepted`, `ReceiptOutcomeDefaulted`, `ReceiptOutcomeCoerced`, `ReceiptOutcomeTransformed`, `ReceiptOutcomeRejected`, `ReceiptOutcomeRolledBack`, and `ReceiptOutcomeCommitted`.

Build one connected, deterministic depth-first execution tree across structs, slices, pointers, primitives, and unions. Record every visited schema boundary under its traversal parent, using the external path selected there. Order struct fields by schema key, elements by actual input
